quality.method: Production Indexes.search, FTS5/sqlite-vec/RRF and authorization. Reduced dimensions are prefix-truncated, renormalized and zero-padded; storage/latency do not simulate a smaller vec0 column. Document encodings reused across dimensions; search includes query encoding. One warm-up per query/mode/dimension; no HTTP overhead.

semantic_query_plan: SEARCH vector_chunks USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_vector_chunks_1 (resource=? AND revision=?)
SEARCH c USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY
search_scale.method: Production search, identical deterministic one-chunk vectors and canonical documents to run_scale. Bulk fixture seeding, no graph work or indexing throughput claim. One warm-up per mode; query encoding included. Synthetic vectors are not semantic-quality evidence.
